```sql
with fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r
      on r.rate_date = c.rate_date
     and r.currency = 'USD'
),
captures as (
    select
        co.name as country_name,
        case
            when a.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
                then '2026-08'
            when a.business_date between date '2025-08-01' and date '2025-08-31'
                then '2025-08'
        end as period_label,
        a.amount_minor,
        a.currency,
        a.business_date,
        row_number() over (
            partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
            order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
        ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join countries co on co.country_code = s.country_code
    where a.status = 'captured'
      and not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and (
          a.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
          or a.business_date between date '2025-08-01' and date '2025-08-31'
      )
)
select
    country_name || ' | ' || period_label as key,
    cast(round(sum(c.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting)) as bigint) as value
from captures c
join fx
  on fx.currency = c.currency
 and fx.rate_date = c.business_date
where c.capture_rank = 1
group by country_name, period_label
order by key asc
```
